measurement: Daemon::snapshot_once on one rewritten file in a 10000-file working copy
profile: local filesystem server, debug test build, controller host

fsmonitor_comparison.reason: Watchman is not installed on either the controller or the validation host; pinned jj 0.38.0 provides the Watchman backend but no service was available for a valid comparison.

claim_scope: One functional and timing run; snapshot_once includes writer-role validation and durable acknowledgement. Every captured commit was read through a cache-disabled client and checked for exact file bytes after its timed interval. This is not a capacity claim.
